subject: Coordinating availability: contract markup review + technical Q&A

Subject: Re: Intro + next steps (contract + tech deep-dive)

Marcus — thanks for the demo last week. Team is generally positive; two asks before legal will move forward: a short technical Q&A with our infra engineers (30–45m) and a contract markup session so our procurement/legal teams can walk through the SOW and a couple of operational clauses.

Can you include your SE and whoever owns privacy/SOC2 commitments? Procurement will want one session that includes legal and our purchasing lead. Suggested window: Aug 20–24, mornings PST. We prefer to keep the sessions separate (tech first, then contract).

Also: can you share the latest SOW and your incident response process doc?

—Alex

Monica (SE) will cover architecture and latency/throughput questions; Laura (Legal) will handle the SOW markup. Vivek (head of sales ops) will join the contract session for commercial questions.

Attaching the current SOW draft and our incident response primer.

- Tue Aug 24 — 10:00–11:30 (tech then contract stack)

- Thu Aug 26 — 08:30–10:00 (separate days)
